Definition: to seethe; figuratively, to be insolent
BiblicalUsage: 1) to boil, boil up, seethe, act proudly, act presumptuously, act rebelliously, be presumptuous, be arrogant, be rebelliously proud; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to act presumptuously; 1a2) to deal arrogantly (with 'al'); 1a3) to defy proudly (with 'el'); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to boil, seethe, act proudly; 1b2) to act presumptuously, act insolently
